projects.title: Developer Portfolio
projects.bodyText:
- Personal developer portfolio built with React and Vite.
- Showcases my technical skills, experience, education, and selected projects.
- Responsive, customizable, and supports both dark and light themes.

projects.title: UAE Real Estate Platform
projects.bodyText:
- Real estate listing platform developed for the UAE property market.
- Integrates property-listing APIs for displaying and managing property information.
- Delivers a modern and responsive browsing experience across different devices.

projects.title: Greenleaf Veggies
projects.bodyText:
- A web application for managing and promoting organic vegetables.
 - Features include product listings, shopping cart functionality, and user reviews.

projects.title: Destination Masterlink (EA) Ltd Website
projects.bodyText:
- A modern website for Destination Masterlink (EA) Ltd, showcasing their services and offerings.
 - Features include a responsive design, interactive elements, and seamless navigation.

projects.title: Savoir Microsystems Website
projects.bodyText:
- Corporate website developed for an ICT and digital-transformation solutions provider.
- Presents software development, mobile and USSD solutions, cloud services, ICT consulting, digital marketing, and industry-specific products.
- Includes service and product pages, case studies, customer testimonials, contact forms, and responsive navigation.

projects.title: Safaricom Bug Bounty Research
projects.bodyText:
- Conducted authorized vulnerability research and responsible disclosure through Safaricom's HackerOne bug bounty program.
- Earned four HackerOne platform badges: Bounty Hunter, TrailBlazer, Insecticide, and Streaker.
- Recognized for receiving a first bounty, being the first to report a vulnerability, having a first report resolved, and achieving two consecutive resolved reports.
